stages.mainLatencyDefinition: One controller clock: frozen planned arrival to correlated application response, including scheduler, queue and dispatch-gate delay. UNKNOWN/queue refusals have separate accounting.
stages.offerTimingDefinition: Exact Aeron offer instant is not exposed. offerObservedAt is first controller observation of ingressOffersAccepted; the offer occurred within [invokeStartedAt,offerObservedAt].
